offering_description.value: Sponsors and manages exchange-traded funds, other investment funds, and digital asset tokenization products, sold to financial advisors, institutions and individual investors. It earns fees on the assets its funds manage and on licensing its indexes.

primary_products.value: exchange-traded funds; commodity and currency exchange-traded products; actively managed funds; tokenized fund products

primary_services.value: investment management; index development and licensing; blockchain-based tokenization services

customer_segment.value: B2B: financial advisors, wealth managers, broker-dealers, institutional investors; B2C: individual investors buying fund shares through brokerage accounts

end_markets.value: asset management; financial services; digital assets

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: management fees charged on assets in its funds; licensing or royalties: fees from third parties licensing its indexes
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sponsors and manages funds for investors, sold to advisors and institutions; software / platform: tokenization platform used to issue digital versions of funds and assets

geography_served.value: global: US, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Middle East investors, with products listed in several markets

specialization.value: related lines: ETFs and ETPs, active funds, index licensing and digital asset products

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: broker-dealers and wealth platforms that distribute its funds; direct sales: institutional and wealth management clients; online: individual investors trading fund shares on brokerage platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC and foreign regulators oversee its registered investment adviser and fund sponsor activities, plus securities and crypto-asset rules
